metadata.title: VSEL Invariant Attack Matrix
metadata.description: Machine-readable invariant attack cases for adversarial security audit

attack_cases.description: Safety invariants can be bypassed via error handling paths that skip validation
preconditions: Error state construction bypasses ValidState check
Constraint system accepts error transitions without semantic validation
attack_cases.expected_violation: Error state with invalid field values accepted by verifier
attack_cases.observable_signal: Invalid state produced via error path without triggering safety checks
attack_cases.mitigation: All paths through Apply must satisfy postcondition ValidState(s'). Error states must be explicitly enumerated and validated. Constraint system must encode error path invariants.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be satisfied vacuously by empty state space
preconditions: Specification defines safety over empty set
attack_cases.expected_violation: System accepts no inputs and produces no states while being 'perfectly safe'
attack_cases.observable_signal: No reachable states exist in the system
attack_cases.mitigation: Non-emptiness requirement: exists s in Reachable(I, T). Initialization must produce at least one valid state. Test suite must verify non-trivial execution.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be weakened by configuration changes to delta_max
preconditions: No lower bound on delta_max in protocol
Configuration change doesn't require safety re-verification
attack_cases.expected_violation: Single transition can rewrite entire state after governance increases delta_max
attack_cases.observable_signal: Governance proposal to increase state mutation bounds
attack_cases.mitigation: Hard upper bound on delta_max in protocol (cannot be changed). Configuration changes require invariant re-verification. Safety-critical parameters immutable.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by reordering transitions to accumulate violations
preconditions: Safety is not truly prefix-closed (specification error)
Multiple transitions interact to violate safety
Constraint system only checks per-transition safety
attack_cases.expected_violation: Safety violation after sequence of individually safe transitions
attack_cases.observable_signal: Accumulated state changes violating global safety invariants
attack_cases.mitigation: Prove safety is prefix-closed: Safe(s) and (s,σ,s') in T implies Safe(s'). Temporal safety invariants: Box Safe(τ). Model checking for safety violation sequences.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by partial execution leaving inconsistent state
preconditions: Failure recovery doesn't roll back all modifications
Constraint system treats partial state as valid
attack_cases.expected_violation: Invalid intermediate state observable after partial transaction failure
attack_cases.observable_signal: Inconsistent state after partial transaction failure
attack_cases.mitigation: Atomicity enforcement: all-or-nothing semantics. State snapshots before transaction. Constraint encoding of atomic operations.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by concurrency race conditions
attack_cases.expected_violation: State inconsistent with transaction log due to race condition
attack_cases.mitigation: Deterministic ordering: VSEL's sequential execution model. State locking during transitions. Constraint system enforces sequential semantics.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by rollback violating T_no_revert
attack_cases.expected_violation: Duplicate state in trace with divergent continuations
attack_cases.observable_signal: Same state appearing at different times in trace
attack_cases.mitigation: Append-only state history. Cryptographic chaining preventing rollback. T_no_revert enforced in constraints.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by hiding transitions from trace
attack_cases.expected_violation: Safety violated in actual execution while appearing satisfied on partial trace
attack_cases.mitigation: Complete trace recording mandatory. State commitment includes full trace. TraceCompleteness proof obligation.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by ambiguous semantic mapping
attack_cases.expected_violation: Safety holds in proof but violated in execution
attack_cases.observable_signal: Same concrete state validates under different semantic interpretations
attack_cases.mitigation: Injective semantic mapping (THM-1). Canonical encoding without ambiguity. Mapping validation in verification.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by upgrade changing safety definition
preconditions: Old proofs accepted under new version
attack_cases.expected_violation: Historical proofs accepted under incompatible safety definitions
attack_cases.observable_signal: Pre-upgrade proofs post-verifying under different semantics
attack_cases.mitigation: Safety invariants immutable across upgrades. Version-specific verification. Proof invalidation on breaking changes.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken by gradual policy relaxation
attack_cases.expected_violation: Progressive relaxation until Safe(s) ≡ True for most states
attack_cases.mitigation: Safety invariants in protocol (immutable). Policy cannot override safety. Mandatory safety regression tests.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken while all tests pass due to incomplete coverage
preconditions: Property-based tests don't cover edge case
attack_cases.expected_violation: Safety violation in production not caught by test suite
attack_cases.observable_signal: Safety violation in production not in test suite
attack_cases.mitigation: Formal verification (exhaustive, not sampled). Model checking of safety properties. Mutation testing for safety checks.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken while local verification passes
preconditions: Global safety depends on non-local state
Constraint system only checks local properties
attack_cases.expected_violation: Local validation passes, global invariant violated
attack_cases.observable_signal: Local validation passes, global invariant violated
attack_cases.mitigation: Global safety invariants in all verification. Cross-reference validation. Complete state verification, not local.

attack_cases.description: Safety can be broken while proof remains valid via underconstraint
preconditions: Safety not fully encoded in constraints
attack_cases.observable_signal: Verifiable proofs for executions violating safety invariants
attack_cases.mitigation: Constraint coverage analysis. Semantic preservation proofs (THM-1). Formal verification of constraint completeness.

cross_cutting_patterns.name: Multi-Layer Invariant Collapse
cross_cutting_patterns.description: Multiple invariants collapse simultaneously when single assumption violated at lower layer
cross_cutting_patterns.example: Cryptographic binding failure cascades to trace integrity, safety, economic, and governance failures
cross_cutting_patterns.mitigation: Defense in depth; each layer assumes lower layers may fail

cross_cutting_patterns.name: Temporal Accumulation Attacks
cross_cutting_patterns.description: Small per-step violations accumulate over time to violate global invariants
cross_cutting_patterns.example: Rounding error 0.0001 per transaction, 10^6 transactions = 100 units extracted

cross_cutting_patterns.name: Proof-Validity Blindness
cross_cutting_patterns.description: System accepts proof as guarantee, ignoring that proof verifies wrong property
cross_cutting_patterns.mitigation: Specification-first proofs, property verification, semantic preservation validation

cross_cutting_patterns.name: Configuration Cascade
cross_cutting_patterns.description: Single configuration change cascades through multiple invariants, weakening them all
cross_cutting_patterns.example: Security parameter reduction affecting cryptographic, access control, economic, and safety invariants
cross_cutting_patterns.mitigation: Configuration impact analysis, invariant preservation under config changes
